name: Telemetry Collector (Cisco NX-OS)
description: Telemetry software stack for Cisco NX-OS supporting both telemetry dial-out and gNMI dial-in, built with Telegraf, InfluxDB, and Grafana.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Automatically builds telemetry collector with Telegraf, Influxdb, and Grafana using docker images with docker-compose.

eval_notes: NX-OS focused telemetry stack. Useful for evaluations involving Cisco Nexus platform telemetry collection.
